messages:
sam: Quick sync — rolling out 'Twist' pricing A/B tomorrow 08:00 PT. A = new tiers, B = legacy + grandfathering. Need invoice template + billing rules verified. @nina please confirm invoice JSON includes grandfathered flag and visible badge.

nina: Will add invoice_metadata.grandfathered=true and badge. Pushed a tiny template PR to staging.

derek: Note: prepaid credit accounts must remain at legacy rates. I'll add routing rule. Also found a $0.01 rounding mismatch in staging samples. Proposing internal 4-decimal calc fix.

maria: Legal/accounting want customers with contract caps forced to B arm. Emma will send exempt list by EOD. Also tax vendor returned unmapped jurisdictions ~1.5% in sample — need invoice note if we apply estimate.

accounting-bot: Staging preview run complete  invoices=86 errors=0 run_id=staging-twist-20260409

tax-vendor-bot: Vendor alert: unmapped_jurisdiction=13 service=avalara recommendation=apply_estimate_note

sam: Action items: 1) nina merge template PR, 2) derek deploy 4-decimal rounding fix, 3) emma publish exempt list, 4) add tax-estimate footer for affected invoices. If staging recon clean, flip to 10% canary.
